free_tier.stated: Withdrawn. The operator published a shutdown notice quoted in the forums: 2026年6月1日 stops new registrations, new purchases, renewals and upgrades; 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 is a migration and refund window; 2026年6月30日 24:00 the service is formally shut down, every affected instance is force-stopped and 数据将被永久销毁 (the data is permanently destroyed). On 2026-10-22 the domain returns HTTP 503.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing composes: a machine that no longer exists cannot host anything, and the notice gives 30 days to move, which is the practical planning number for any small host.
limits_note: The binding fact is the closure date. The refund was pro-rata by remaining billing period, by ticket, and only to the original payment rail; a machine transferred between accounts with no payment record was refused.
binding_note: The binding fact is the closure date. The refund was pro-rata by remaining billing period, by ticket, and only to the original payment rail; a machine transferred between accounts with no payment record was refused.

identity_cost.detail: Moot: the product cannot be bought. The earlier signup route was not recorded.

evidence.proved: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable returned for the site root, one-line body No server is available to handle this request
the shutdown notice is reposted with its dates: 2026-06-01 stop new purchases and renewals, 2026-06-30 24:00 服务正式关停, and 数据将被永久销毁, quoted from the thread body in the search snippet
a second copy of the same notice states 2026年6月30日 起，正式关停 VPS 及相关托管业务, quoted
a customer posts the vendor's refund reply, which confirms 云服务 being discontinued effective June 30, 2026 and pro-rata refunds by ticket date
HTTP 530 on 2026-10-24: the free container product's own host does not answer, which is consistent with the published 2026-06-30 shutdown

notes: The notice names VPS, VDS and related hosting. Whether the separate free container product on the same brand is also gone is inferred from the 503 on the shared domain, not established by a notice about that product. Confirmed 2026-10-24: run.claw.cloud, the separate free-container host, returns a HTTP 530. The inference that the container product went down with the host is now supported by that host being unreachable.
